data.name: Jeeval
data.long_meaning: The name 'Jeeval' comes from the Sanskrit word 'jeevan' which means 'lively' or 'vibrant'. It is often used to describe someone who is full of life and energy. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is known as the 'preserver of life' or 'jeevan prakashak'. This name is a tribute to the divine power of life and vitality.
